fix(nix): refresh stale tui npmDepsHash + fix cache-blind detection (#20144)

The fix-lockfiles script used 'nix build .#tui.npmDeps' to detect stale
hashes. This always succeeds when the OLD derivation is cached in Cachix
or cache.nixos.org — even when the source package-lock.json has changed.

Fix: use prefetch-npm-deps to compute the hash directly from the lockfile
and compare against what's in the nix file. Falls back to nix build only
if prefetch-npm-deps fails.

5/5 下午调查 4 小时, 反复重启 / 改代码 / 找 LLM 错误 / 找 SDK 限制, 全是错的方向.
真根因是我 5/4 改 AsyncConfig.java 的 corePool 从 10000→50 (省内存意图).

为啥这是元凶:
  Java 内部 SDK 协议处理大量用 @Async (FriendTalkNotice 接收 / 文件接收 /
  转发 PC 端 / 落库), 这些都走 AsyncConfig 的 thread pool.
  corePool=50 + maxPool=500 + queue=10000 看着够, 但 SDK 高峰单条媒体推送
  触发几十个并发 @Async, 50 被打满 → 走 CallerRunsPolicy → 调用线程是
  Netty event loop → 阻塞 Netty → 文件接收/上传超时丢弃 → URL 留手机本地.

to the originating platform instead of staying in a local subagent thread.

  → bundle persisted to SecretsStore + yaml `auth.bundle = <path>`

exactly-one-of-{api_key_env,api_key_secret_id,api_key_secret_value}

live in the bundle persisted by `oauth_finish`.

fix(picture): skip zero-valued anchor hPosition/vPosition on Get

Anchor pictures positioned by Align (not PositionOffset) had no offset
in the source dump, but AddPicture defaults the offset to 0 — the next
dump emitted hPosition=0.0cm and vPosition=0.0cm, jittering the round
trip. Treat 0 as 'no override' so the dump stays idempotent.

fix(get): treat empty <w:lang/> as 'no language override' instead of lang=true

Word/WPS occasionally write a bare <w:lang/> with no attributes as a
'reset to default language' sentinel. The long-tail FillUnknownChildProps
fallback surfaced that as Format["lang"] = true, which Set then parsed as
a BCP-47 tag and rejected with 'Invalid BCP-47 'true''. Skip lang in
the curated list so the canonical .latin/.ea/.cs reader stays the single
source of truth.

fix(style): preserve unnamed style identity instead of auto-filling name from id

When AddStyle was called with only id (no name) the styleName fallback
defaulted to the id, so a docx whose original style had id+empty-name
round-tripped to id+name=id. Track whether the caller passed name
explicitly and emit empty <w:name w:val=""/> when not. The duplicate-name
check skips empty-name styles too so multiple unnamed styles round-trip.

fix(images): preserve file uid/gid in docker-built ext4 rootfs (#255)

The Docker path of `_create_ext4_with_docker` was extracting the
container-export tar on the host (as the unprivileged build-process
uid — 501 on macOS, 1001 on GitHub-hosted runners) before handing the
tree to `mke2fs -d` inside an Alpine container. `mke2fs -d` propagates
the source tree's on-disk uid/gid into ext4 inodes verbatim, so every
file in the resulting rootfs ended up owned by the host runner uid
instead of root.
